sessions.phase_label: Implementation, visual review, and initial deployment

requirements.title: Product and Customer Value Messaging
requirements.definition: The landing page must market disposable branded kids bibs to restaurants and fast-food chains while emphasizing benefits for families and restaurant quality.
requirements.boundary_note: Product description, business audience, family value, and restaurant-quality benefits are coupled parts of one marketing-message mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Kids and Restaurant Visual Theme
requirements.definition: The landing page must use lively and attractive visual material that evokes children and a restaurant atmosphere.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers the ambient visual style and selection of attractive kids-and-restaurant imagery; use of the client's specific product pictures is independently changeable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Product Image Customization
requirements.definition: The reference design must be customized with imagery of the client's bib product.
requirements.boundary_note: Client-specific product images can be added or replaced independently of the page's general kids-and-restaurant visual theme.

requirements.title: Embedded Product Video
requirements.definition: The landing page must include the video supplied by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Video inclusion is an independently enabled and verifiable page feature, not merely an attribute of static imagery.

requirements.title: Shareable Landing-Page Link Access
requirements.definition: The completed landing page must be deployed at a working clickable link that the client can send to selected customers for viewing.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns online reachability through a shareable link. The reference to specific customers describes client-controlled link distribution and does not establish authentication or technical access restrictions.

requirements.title: CTA Redirect to Facebook
requirements.definition: The landing page call-to-action button must redirect visitors to the Facebook page selected by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: CTA navigation is independently testable and can change without modifying page messaging, media, or deployment. Earlier destination uncertainty is resolved by the later Facebook decision.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client says they do not use Shopify and the freelancer recommends WordPress with Elementor, but the history does not clearly show that the client prohibited Shopify or accepted the proposed platform.
A freelancer message references an FAQ section, but no supplied client message clearly requests or accepts an FAQ deliverable.
A contact form is discussed, but its inclusion, audience, and fields are never authoritatively resolved.
It is unclear whether the client intended the supplied phrase as page copy, a page title, or a customized URL name; the subsequent exchange only establishes limitations of the free-domain link.
